theory.intro: Sometimes the probability is given and the mean or the standard deviation is missing. Turn the probability into a $z$ value first, then substitute into $z=\frac{x-\mu}{\sigma}$ and solve for the unknown.
facts: The table gives $P(Z\le z)$ for positive $z$, so find the probability in the body and read $z$ off the edges.
If $P(X<c)$ is greater than $0.5$ then $c$ lies above the mean, so $z$ is positive.
For a negative $z$ use symmetry: $P(Z<-z)=1-P(Z<z)$, so look up $1$ minus the given probability.
Change a 'greater than' probability to a 'less than' one first, using $P(X>c)=1-P(X<c)$.
Rearranging $z=\frac{x-\mu}{\sigma}$ gives $\mu=x-z\sigma$ when the standard deviation is known.

Rearranging instead gives $\sigma=\frac{x-\mu}{z}$ when the mean is known and $z\ne0$, and $\sigma$ is always positive. If $x=\mu$ and the probability is $0.5$, the information does not determine the standard deviation.
Check the answer by asking whether the score really does sit on the side of the mean the probability requires.
steps: Decide the sign of $z$ from the side of the mean the score lies on
Find the size of $z$ from the table

workedExamples.question_text:
Use the standard normal table to find $z$ in each case.
(a) $P(Z<z)=0.8907$.
(b) $P(Z<z)=0.1093$.
(c) $P(Z>z)=0.1093$.
The relevant table extract is:
$\begin{array}{c|ccc} &0.01&0.02&0.03\\\hline 1.1&0.8665&0.8686&0.8708\\1.2&0.8869&0.8888&0.8907\\1.3&0.9049&0.9066&0.9082\end{array}$
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) The left-hand probability exceeds $0.5$, so $z$ is positive. The entry $0.8907$ is in row $1.2$, column $0.03$.
$z=1.23$.

(b) The left-hand probability is below $0.5$, so $z$ is negative. Use symmetry to look up its positive counterpart.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}1-0.1093\\&=0.8907\end{aligned}$
Thus $z=-1.23$.

(c) Convert the right-hand probability to a left-hand probability.
$\begin{aligned}P(Z<z)&=1-0.1093\\&=0.8907\end{aligned}$
Thus $z=1.23$.

workedExamples.question_text:
$X$ is normally distributed with standard deviation $7$. Given $P(X<68)=0.9772$, find the mean $\mu$.
Use the table entry $P(Z<2)=0.9772$.

A machine fills bottles with volumes that are normally distributed with standard deviation $3$ mL. Find the mean volume required so that $0.13\%$ of bottles contain less than $240$ mL.
Use $P(Z<3)=0.9987$.

$X$ is normally distributed with standard deviation $12$. Given $P(X>72)=0.9332$, find the mean.
Use $P(Z<1.5)=0.9332$.

For each normal distribution, find $\sigma$.
(a) The mean is $60$ and $P(X<48)=0.0668$.
(b) The mean is $60$ and $P(X>80)=0.0062$.
Use $P(Z<1.5)=0.9332$ and $P(Z<2.5)=0.9938$.
Battery lives are normally distributed with mean $32$ hours. Exactly $5\%$ have lives below $27$ hours. Use inverse normal on a calculator to find the standard deviation to one decimal place.

The probability is greater than $0.5$, so $z$ is positive.
$0.9772$ sits in the row $2.0$ and the column $0.00$.
$z$

$1-0.0228$

$z$

$=1-0.0668$

$z$

The probability is greater than $0.5$, so $38$ lies above the mean and $z$ is positive.
$z=2$
$2=\frac{38-\mu}{4}$

foundation.question_text:
$X$ is normally distributed with mean $30$.
Given that $P(X<38)=0.8413$, find the standard deviation $\sigma$.
Use $P(Z<1)=0.8413$.
foundation.solution_text:
The probability is greater than $0.5$, so $38$ lies above the mean and $z$ is positive.
$z=1$
$1=\frac{38-30}{\sigma}$
$\sigma=8$

The probability is less than $0.5$, so $38$ lies below the mean and $z$ is negative.
$1-0.1587$
$=0.8413$
$z=-1$
$-1=\frac{38-50}{\sigma}$
$-\sigma=-12$
$\sigma=12$

foundation.question_text:
$X$ is normally distributed with standard deviation $5$.
Given that $P(X>90)=0.9332$, find the mean $\mu$.
Use $P(Z<1.5)=0.9332$.
foundation.solution_text:
$P(X<90)$
$=1-0.9332$
$=0.0668$
This is less than $0.5$, so $90$ lies below the mean and $z$ is negative.
$z=-1.5$
$-1.5=\frac{90-\mu}{5}$
$-7.5=90-\mu$
$\mu=97.5$

mastery.question_text:
$X$ is normally distributed with mean $54$.
Given that $P(X>73.5)=0.0668$, find the standard deviation $\sigma$.
Use $P(Z<1.5)=0.9332$.
mastery.solution_text:
$P(X<73.5)$
$=1-0.0668$
$=0.9332$
This is greater than $0.5$, so $73.5$ lies above the mean and $z$ is positive.
$z=1.5$
$1.5=\frac{73.5-54}{\sigma}$
$1.5\sigma=19.5$
$\sigma=13$

mastery.question_text:
Bolt lengths are normally distributed with a mean of $40$ mm on both of a factory's machines.
Machine A rejects the $2.28\%$ of bolts shorter than $37.6$ mm, while machine B rejects only $0.62\%$ at the same length.
Find the standard deviation of each machine.
Use $P(Z<2)=0.9772$ and $P(Z<2.5)=0.9938$.
mastery.solution_text:
$37.6$ mm is below the mean in both cases, so both $z$ values are negative.
For machine A, $1-0.0228=0.9772$, so $z=-2$.
$-2=\frac{37.6-40}{\sigma}$
$-2\sigma=-2.4$
$\sigma=1.2$ mm
For machine B, $1-0.0062=0.9938$, so $z=-2.5$.
$-2.5=\frac{37.6-40}{\sigma}$
$-2.5\sigma=-2.4$
$\sigma=0.96$ mm

Use $P(Z<0.5)=0.6915$.
mastery.solution_text:

$1-0.3085$
$=0.6915$
$z=-0.5$
$-0.5=\frac{45-\mu}{8}$
$-4=45-\mu$
